UCAS points G6 8/10/12, G7 12/14/16, G8 18/24/30 (Pass/Merit/Distinction).

Three pieces from the current repertoire list: two accompanied from Group A and one unaccompanied from Group B. At Initial-G3 one Group A piece may be a duet (upper part; duet part on a woodwind instrument, live or recorded). Own composition may replace a piece (accompanied -> Group A, unaccompanied -> Group B), comparable in demand (Initial 0.5-1 min up to G8 3.5-5 min; stave notation required G6-8; no marks for quality of composition). Flute, clarinet and saxophone candidates may swap one piece for a Jazz Woodwind piece listed for the same instrument, grade and group. Instrument rules: piccolo/alto flute, Eb/bass clarinet, cor anglais, contrabassoon only where listed (max one such piece); recorder G6-8 must play both descant and treble, only one piece on tenor/sopranino/bass; no plastic saxophones. Repeats over 4 bars not played; da capo/dal segno observed; no metronomes; memory optional (no extra marks). Accompanist supplied by candidate; backing tracks allowed to G3 face-to-face (live from G4), and at all grades digitally.

Digital exams (filmed, one continuous take, up to 3GB) offer two pathways: Technical work (3 pieces + scales/arpeggios Set A or B, or exercises, or G6-8 orchestral extracts/study, + overall performance mark) or Repertoire-only (4 pieces: at least two Group A and one Group B, 25 marks each). sections: Scales & technical work

Scales & arpeggios (from memory; examiner selects): scales F, G major, E minor (harmonic/melodic/natural), one octave; arpeggios F, G major, E minor; tongued or slurred, mf; min tempi: scales crotchet=56, arpeggios quaver=80. Digital: same material split into fixed Set A or Set B (all from memory); choose one. Or exercises (music may be used): prepare three, one from each pair, and play two (candidate chooses first, examiner the second; digital: choose two from different groups). Tone & phrasing: Curves / Rising and Falling; articulation: Neat and Tidy / Tee-ya-ti-dum; finger technique: Like a CD / Smooth.
Sight-reading
Unseen extract ~2 grades lower, 30 s preparation; range an octave; keys (cumulative): F, G major.
Aural & other tests

Two of four tests (10 marks each): sight reading; aural; improvisation; musical knowledge. Aural (4-bar melody, major key, 2 or 3 time): clap pulse (3rd hearing); identify dynamic f/p and legato/staccato; last note higher or lower than first (first two bars); spot where a rhythm/pitch change occurs. Improvisation: stylistic - 4 bars played twice (8 bars), F/G major, I/V, fanfare or moderato; motivic - 2-bar fragment, response 4-8 bars, F/G major, up to a major 3rd; harmonic - 4-bar sequence x2, I/V, C major.
